arguments.question: What did the September 15-16, 2026 FOMC statement/projections say about the policy stance and financial conditions relevant over the next 21–63 sessions, and is there any measured evidence linking higher funding costs to AI-infrastructure capex?
arguments.decision_impact: Tests whether monetary-policy conditions could plausibly transmit through customer/infrastructure financing into NVIDIA demand; absent measured exposure, do not quantify an impact.
